name: Seeds & Graves Garden Problem [TESTING]
desc:
Welcome to Seeds & Graves Garden Problem [Testing]


A Seeds & Graves Game.

Fight as a Plant or a Zombie in a epic third person shooter 
In a intense fight of Bloom vs Gloom

Play this epic war between plants and zombies

Controls:
[LMB] to Shoot
[RMB] to Zoom
[Shift] to Sprint
[1] to use First Ability
[2] to use Second Ability
[3] to use Third Ability

Credits:
All Soundtracks made by ViksoChah @Vex0ppt3097
Lobby Plants and Zombies by Geners
House models by Bobby

expect some bugs because its currently on alpha mode..

Highly inspired by Plants vs Zombies Garden Warfare and PvZ / Plants vs Zombies
